The '''Panna system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].<ref name="ea" /> It contained the planet [[Panna/Legends|Panna]] and [[Panna Prime]], its moon.<ref name="TSOTFW" />

==History==
The system contained seven [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and 35 [[Moon/Legends|moons]], with at least Panna Prime being able to support life.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The population consisted mostly of an assortment of pirates, outlaws, traders and prospectors, with the system characterized by the three major gas giants and the extensive asteroid belts around them.<ref name="HOXATTC" />

When he prepared his overthrow of the [[Cronese]] King [[Ferece]], the pirate-lord [[Xer VIII|Xer]] was known to have gathered a sizable fleet in this system.<ref name="HOXATTC" />
Millennia later, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the droids [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] came to this system to look for the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. They encountered the bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and were almost captured by him.<ref name="TSOTFW" /> By this time, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had increased its presence in the system and stationed troops there.<ref name="TSOTFW" />

==Behind the scenes==
An animatic for ''The Star Wars Holiday Special''{{'s}} animated segment indicates that the Panna system has 37 planets and 35 moons.<ref name="SWArchive-Holiday Special Animatic Reel">{{SWArchive|url=video/view/000717.html|text=Holiday Special Animatic Reel|nobackup=1}}</ref> The number of planets was scaled down in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
